data.name: Space Trader Corps
data.detailed_description:
Somewhere out past Terra, a port is starving for the cargo you're sitting on.



SPACE TRADER CORPS is a real-time multiplayer space trading game in the spirit of the classic BBS legends — reimagined with one-click flight, a living economy, and a persistent shared galaxy that keeps turning whether you're docked or not.

Trade a Living Economy


Ten commodities. Thousands of ports. Every price set by real supply and demand — ports sell cheap when stocked and pay a premium when starved, and every trade you make moves the market. Read a planet's type to guess what it buys before you ever dock, log every port in your personal codex, and save the routes that print credits. Then automate them and watch your freighters work while you chase the next opportunity.

Command a Fleet, Not Just a Ship


Start in a humble Scout and climb through freighters, warships, and alien-hunting hulls to capital-class dreadnoughts. Fly every hull you own at once: set one ship auto-trading a route, send another to strip an asteroid field, dispatch a scout to survey the frontier — and take the helm of any of them, any time, from anywhere on the map.

Claim Worlds. Build an Empire.


Land colonists on an empty world and it's yours. Grow its population, raise mines, factories, and defense grids, collect taxes across your holdings, and crown a finished world with a towering spaceport that can ferry colonists to your next conquest. Rival captains can see what you've built — and some of them will want it.

Fight for Your Cargo


Space is not safe. Launch drone flights at pirates, rival captains, and alien raiders; screen your convoys with escorts and point-defense lasers; seed the space lanes with proximity mines — or sweep an ambush aside and claim the wreckage. Planetary defense grids answer for their owners. Go outlaw and the galaxy answers for itself.

Push into the Dark


Warp gates link the charted lanes; violet rifts fling you across the galaxy; the frontier beyond has never been visited by anyone. Chart it first and sell the knowledge with your trade empire. Multiple galaxy regions mean there is always an untamed map — and a fresh leaderboard — waiting.

And When You Dock...


Join a guild and run routes with friends. Try your luck in the station casino. Hatch and raise a pet that skims a little profit into its feeding bowl. Take rescue contracts, jump salvage claims, climb the wealth ranks from Deckhand to legend — and unlock Steam achievements as you rise.



One galaxy. Every captain for themselves. How rich will you get?

data.short_description: A real-time multiplayer space trading game in a shared persistent galaxy. Haul cargo across a living player-driven galaxy, mine asteroids, colonize and industrialize planets, become a pirate (or a hunt them), or out-trade every other captain - solo or with your friends. PvP & PvE.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz dual-core x64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or later)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or newer (64-bit), or SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz dual-core x64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
